POST.name: clients - Creates a client

GET.name: clients/{client_id} - Retrieves a client

PATCH.name: clients/{client_id} - Updates a client

GET.name: clients/{client_id} - Retrieves a list of account contracts for a specified client
clients/{client_id} - Retrieves a list of card contracts for a specified client

PUT.name: clients/{client_id} - Resets Online PIN Try Counter

POST.name: clients/{client_id}/addresses - Creates an address for a client

GET.name: clients/{client_id}/addresses - Retrieves a list of addresses for the client

PUT.name: clients/{client_id}/addresses - Updates an address of a selected type for the client

GET.name: clients/{client_id}/classifiers - Retrieves a client classifier

PUT.name: clients/{client_id}/classifiers - Sets up a client classifier
